reviews.text: I got this shampoo for my twins and it feels very nice! It leaves their hair with a nice scent and looking shiny :)
reviews.zh: 我買呢款洗頭水俾我對孖仔用，用起嚟好舒服！洗完頭髮有好香嘅味道，又見到光澤。:)

reviews.text: Great kids shampoo! Lathers well and leaves the hair smelling nice.
reviews.zh: 好好用嘅兒童洗頭水！起泡好，洗完頭髮都好香。

reviews.text: Broken bottle with a squashed box. Not the best I have received.
reviews.zh: 瓶子裂咗，盒子都壓扁咗。我收過嘅貨裏面，呢次唔係最好嘅。

reviews.text: This brought my hair back to life!!!! It leaves my hair so soft and shiny!
reviews.zh: 令我嘅頭髮活返過嚟！！！！頭髮變得好軟、好有光澤！

reviews.text: My daughter like this a lot and it also has a nice smell.
reviews.zh: 我女好鍾意呢款，而且味道都好好聞。

reviews.text: Smells like daffidol, my husband also loves it. I got this whole line because of the smells
reviews.zh: 聞落似 daffidol，我老公都好鍾意。我因為啲香味先買咗成個系列。

reviews.text: Nice scent and very soft. My kids love it so much. Will buy it again soon.
reviews.zh: 香味好好，質感好軟。我嘅小朋友好鍾意，會好快再買。

reviews.text: Hydrating, gentle yet effective for children. Nice subtle scent and absorbs quickly.
reviews.zh: 保濕、溫和，但對小朋友嚟講都好有效。香味淡淡哋幾好聞，而且好快吸收。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
